rows.note: This is the all-purpose everyday way to refer to how complex something is.

example.traditional: 呢個程式嘅複雜程度高唔高呀？
example.jyutping: ni1 go3 cing4 sik1 ge3 fuk1 zaap6 cing4 dou6 gou1 m4 gou1 aa3

rows.note: Use this more formal noun when discussing complexity as an abstract property, especially in writing.

example.english: The complexity of this system is quite high.
example.traditional: 呢個系統嘅複雜性相當高。
example.jyutping: ni1 go3 hai6 tung2 ge3 fuk1 zaap6 sing3 soeng1 dong1 gou1
